SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS n_distinct, MIN(order_ts_utc) AS mn, MAX(order_ts_utc) AS mx
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY ROLLUP(status)
ORDER BY 1

WITH o AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_web_order
  WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01' AND status <> 'cancelled'
),
t AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, MAX(CASE WHEN p.category = 'ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_test, COUNT(*) AS lines, COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores, MAX(s.store_id) AS store_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM o) GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(CASE WHEN t.receipt_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_lines, SUM(COALESCE(t.has_test,0)) AS test_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.store_id<>900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non900, SUM(CASE WHEN o.line_count<>t.lines THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linecount_mismatch,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.status='processing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS processing
FROM o LEFT JOIN t ON t.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
